# Routing and Containment Checklist: Model routing per Spec Kit phase

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of `003-sdd-model-routing` — the orchestration of a routed run, and the containment of the external agent and its credential
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: the reviewer before `/speckit-tasks`. Focus: the
two highest-relevance clusters, orchestration and containment (the command's
defaults when interaction is impossible; run under the owner's delegation of
2026-10-21).

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the model for every phase stated somewhere a reader can find, including verify and review, not only the phases named in FR-001's scenario? [Completeness, Spec §US1 AS1, contracts/workflow.md]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec define what "the feature's files" are that phases hand over through, so FR-002 can be judged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the checkpoints FR-004 lists the same as the gates in contracts/workflow.md, including `answer-clarify`, `fix-stuck` and `converge-stuck`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified who or what marks tasks `[X]` in a routed run, and on which evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Are the requirements for a routed run that is not opted in (implementation on Sonnet) as complete as those for the external path — verify, review and loop limits included? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Is the content the external agent receives (tasks, constitution, test-first rules) defined precisely enough to tell a complete brief from a partial one? [Clarity, Spec §US2 AS1]
- [x] CHK007 Are the prerequisites FR-011 covers listed exhaustively, with the phase each one is checked at? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, contracts/sdd-run.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "contained to the feature's worktree" defined for reads as well as writes, and for network access? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Is "no access to the owner's credentials other than the one it needs" defined so a reviewer can list what the agent can and cannot reach? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 Is the set of "lint, format, type-check or test configuration" files defined, or delegated to a named source of truth? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, research R7]
- [x] CHK011 Is "findings above LOW" tied to a severity scale that converge actually emits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Is "fresh context" defined so that a review in the same process as the code's author would fail it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do US2 AS4 and FR-015 agree on what happens after two failed fix rounds, and with contracts/workflow.md's `fix-loop` of three iterations? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK014 Is the Assumption that story-workers stays installed consistent with a routed run's implement step bypassing it, and is the interaction specified? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Does FR-003's "MUST NOT edit files Spec Kit installs" hold for `specify workflow add` copying the workflow into `.specify/workflows/`? [Consistency, constitution V]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Is SC-001's baseline arm defined precisely enough to be rerun — which steps on which model, which implement path, which fixture state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 Is it stated how SC-001 counts usage the subscription spends but a step does not report (retries, a failed step, the converge loop's extra passes)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-003's probe defined by what it attempts, so "0 writes land" has a fixed denominator? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK019 Can SC-005's "one answer per checkpoint" be met by the clarify checkpoint, where the owner writes several answers? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-005]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a run interrupted mid-step (terminal closed, machine asleep) and resumed? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the external agent leaving the worktree dirty or partially changed when it fails mid-pass? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [x] CHK022 Is the behaviour specified when a phase's headless process is refused a permission it needs — does the run fail, and how does the owner widen the allow list? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the external provider's spend exceeding a bound within one run? [Coverage, Non-Functional, Gap]
- [x] CHK024 Is the case of a repository with no single check command (the verify step's input) addressed? [Coverage, Dependency, Gap]

## Non-Functional: Security and Privacy

- [x] CHK025 Is it specified what the external provider may retain of the code sent, and is the owner told before the first opt-in? [Privacy, Spec §FR-010, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Are the places the credential must never appear listed exhaustively (arguments, environment of the host process, files, image layers, container configuration, run state, logs)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, contracts/sdd-step.md]
- [x] CHK027 Is untrusted agent output kept out of shell commands by a stated requirement, not only by the contract? [Security, contracts/workflow.md "Guarantees", Gap]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Is the dependency on Apple's `container` stated with the macOS version it needs and what happens on a machine without it? [Dependency, research R5]
  - **Accepted open, 2026-10-21 (owner's delegation):** the runtime is undecided until T002 observes whether Apple `container` grants `NET_ADMIN` for the firewall, falling back to colima; T002 records the runtime, its macOS requirement and its first-start state in research R5, and this item is judged again then.
- [x] CHK029 Is the assumption that pi follows a brief's test-first rules stated as an assumption to be measured, not a requirement met by construction? [Assumption, Spec §US2]
- [x] CHK030 Are the version pins this feature relies on (Spec Kit's workflow engine, pi 1.3.0, the DeepSeek model ids) named with what happens when each moves? [Dependency, Spec §US1 AS6]
